# FLX-3602: a consumers dialect is not one the engine reads

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The dialect names the SQL the consumers write in, and it is one of a closed list of sqlglot dialect names (duckdb when the block names none). The message lists them.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3602
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
